subject: AWS co-sell intro + discovery / mutual action plan checklist for Habitat Health
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Reyes <amelia@habitathealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: AWS co-sell intro + discovery / mutual action plan checklist for Habitat Health

Hi Amelia —

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. As discussed, we’d like to get a short discovery call on the calendar with your procurement and engineering leads plus our AWS BD to scope the co-sell alignment. Goal: confirm timeline, procurement gates, and measurements we’ll use in the mutual action plan (MAP).

Suggested agenda (30–45m):
- 10m: Introductions & business objectives
- 10–15m: Technical constraints + data residency
- 5–10m: Procurement timeline & decision checkpoints
- 5–10m: Next steps / MAP owner & deadlines

Proposed times: Tue 11/3 10:00–10:45 PT, Wed 11/4 09:00–09:45 PT, or Thu 11/5 14:00–14:45 PT. Happy to adjust if those don’t work.

I’ve attached a short MAP checklist that we use to capture owners, milestones, and procurement docs so we can come to the call with a draft. Could you confirm:
1) who will represent procurement and engineering on your side?
2) any procurement deadlines we should be aware of (RFx/RFP dates, budget cycle)?
3) preference for AWS BD involvement on the kickoff?

Attachments: [attachment: ma-checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)], [attachment: redwood-capacity-estimate.pdf]

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Redwood Inference — Production-grade LLM inference, predictable economics
From: Amelia Reyes <amelia@habitathealth.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T10:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS co-sell intro + discovery / mutual action plan checklist for Habitat Health

Logan —

Thanks for the clear notes. Wed 11/4 09:00 PT looks best for us. I’ll have our Head of Procurement (Sanjay Patel) and Lead Platform Engineer (Amelia is primary but will invite platform lead) on the call. Our internal deadline for vendor selection is targeting Dec 15 to align with our Q1 rollout planning.

We definitely want AWS BD on the kickoff — they’ve been encouraging a co-sell approach for this account. I’m attaching our current RFP outline so you and your team can scan for gaps ahead of the call.

One ask: can you include a short cost/ops slide on expected per-token economics for our baseline workload? That will help procurement triage versus other vendors.

Attachments: [attachment: habitat-rfp-outline.docx]

Appreciate it — see you Wed 11/4 09:00 PT.

Best,
Amelia Reyes
VP of Partnerships | Habitat Health
amelia@habitathealth.com | (202) 555-0147

Tom — quick context: Habitat Health is evaluating inference for a patient-facing triage and summarization feature. They’re targeting vendor selection by Dec 15 and Q1 rollout. Logan shared a MAP checklist; we’ll collaborate to capture procurement milestones and any marketplace listing prerequisites (SLA/contracting, security attestations).

Hi all —

Thanks for the invite and context. I’ll join the Wed 11/4 09:00 PT meeting. Quick asks to make the kickoff productive:
- please send the attendee list and titles (execs + procurement rep)
- if you have a short one-pager on baseline performance/cost assumptions, share it ahead so we can bring relevant AWS resources (solution architects / marketplace ops)
- any compliance gates (SOC2/HIPAA, data residency) up front helps us scope marketplace requirements

We can also talk marketplace listing cadence during the call — if Habitat is open to listing the solution via AWS Marketplace, that often smooths procurement and may enable co-sell credits.
